question: Find the name and location of the universities that did not have any staff participated in any conference in 2004.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conferences" AS SELECT "conference_id" AS "conference_id", "location" AS "location", "conference_info" AS "conference_info" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "institutions" AS SELECT "institution_id" AS "institution_id", "institution_name" AS "institution_name", "location" AS "location", "founded" AS "founded" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "staff" AS SELECT "staff_id" AS "staff_id", "name" AS "name", "age" AS "age", "canada" AS "canada", "united_kindom" AS "united_kindom", "united_states" AS "united_states" FROM table_3;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "participation" AS SELECT "huiyi_id" AS "huiyi_id", "yuangong_id" AS "yuangong_id", "role" AS "role" FROM table_4;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT i.institution_name AS university_name,
       i.location AS university_location,
       'No staff-to-institution linkage; cannot determine participation by university' AS note,
       (SELECT num_conf_2004 FROM stats_tmp) AS conferences_2004_count,
       (SELECT num_staff_part_2004 FROM stats_tmp) AS staff_participated_2004_count
FROM institutions i
ORDER BY i.institution_name
LIMIT 10;
S:
# Assumptions noted: There is no explicit staff-to-institution mapping; infer institution via staff name is impossible. Therefore, return all institutions as having no participating staff in 2004 due to missing linkage, but also include counts for transparency.

# Build small stats and then emit preview-sized table.

stats_df = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
WITH conf_2004 AS (
  SELECT conference_id
  FROM conferences
  WHERE conference_info ILIKE '%2004%'
), staff_participated_2004 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.yuangong_id
  FROM participation p
  JOIN conf_2004 c ON c.conference_id = p.huiyi_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_conf_2004,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff_participated_2004) AS num_staff_part_2004;
""")

# Register the tiny stats as a temp table for SQL reference
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, stats_df, 'stats_tmp')

# Final small result (preview): all institutions with a note and stats
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT i.institution_name AS university_name,
       i.location AS university_location,
       'No staff-to-institution linkage; cannot determine participation by university' AS note,
       (SELECT num_conf_2004 FROM stats_tmp) AS conferences_2004_count,
       (SELECT num_staff_part_2004 FROM stats_tmp) AS staff_participated_2004_count
FROM institutions i
ORDER BY i.institution_name
LIMIT 10;
""")
